howItWorks.title: How SmartScan Stay Elevates Your Property
howItWorks.subtitle: Replace 30-page laminated binders with verified neural intelligence and precision stay kits that wow every guest.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Record 60-second voice notes walking through your property. AI transcribes, cleans and structures them into knowledge cards.
howItWorks.step1MemoText: "The hot water heater booster switch is inside the laundry cabinet..."
howItWorks.step2Desc: Download ready-to-print luxury acrylic or wood stand templates (300+ DPI PDF). Place them on nightstands or kitchen counters.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Guests scan and get instant answers in their native language. Zero app download, zero account creation, zero barrier.

features.title: Engineered Exclusively for Luxury Vacation Rentals
features.subtitle: Every feature is calibrated to protect host peace of mind while creating a flawless 5-star guest experience.
features.card1Title: 100% Verified Property Facts · Zero AI Hallucinations
features.card1Desc: The AI concierge answers solely from your verified property manual and notes. It never invents incorrect check-in codes, Wi-Fi passwords, or pool rules.
features.card1Footer: Strict privacy and data isolation between different properties.
features.card1VisualPoint1: Approved notes only: Wi-Fi passwords, appliance guides, house rules, and emergency contacts.
features.card1VisualPoint2: Zero guessing: The AI strictly adheres to your manual and never invents unverified information.
features.card2Desc: Direct Server-Sent Events streaming delivers token answers in under 1.2s, feeling faster than typing to a human concierge.
features.card2Footer: Zero spinning wheels or stalled requests.
features.card3Desc: You write in English or Bulgarian; guests read and chat in German, French, Italian, Greek, Romanian, Hebrew, or Japanese seamlessly.
features.card3Footer: Host input once → Polyglot answers worldwide.
features.card4Title: Failsafe Escalation (Direct Host WhatsApp / Urgent Dispatch)
features.card4Desc: For water leaks, power outages, or special requests, 1-tap WhatsApp and phone escalation connects guests directly to your emergency contact. AI handles 86% of routine FAQs; you only step in when it truly matters.
features.card4Footer: Host phone & WhatsApp numbers stored securely in encrypted spaces metadata.
